Subject: Prospera — quick ask: reference to validate scaling to 10k TPS?

Hi Ben / Lauren,

Quick context: Prospera (late-stage payments stack; closing next week) wants concrete proof points on our ability to handle high-throughput settlement workloads across US regions. Deal team (me) estimates they need reassurance on 10k TPS sustained bursts and our end-to-end latencies under multi-tenant load.

Ask: can you source a customer (payments/settlement/clearing) who has done a scale validation with Redwood in the past 12 months and is willing to do a 30-min technical reference call? Ideally someone who: 
- handles ACH/real-time rails and does reconciliation pipelines
- is comfortable talking about batch sizing, KV cache impacts, and routing policies
- is US-based (east or central)

Ben — please check the advocate roster and flag 1–2 candidates. Lauren — can you prep a short two-slide one-pager summarizing the pilot footprint and the specific prompts/seq lengths we used (I attached the draft scope below)?

I want to reach out to Prospera by EOD with a proposed reference slot.

Thanks,
